meta.source: BGV Brand Kit v1.0 (bgv-tokens.json) + design system decisions
meta.note: Brand primitives and semantic light/dark roles are copied exactly from the brand kit. States, status colours, shadows, table, seats, clocks and tiers are the design system's.

tokens.name: brand-green
tokens.usage: Brand primitive «سبز میز». Do not use directly in UI; use semantic roles.

tokens.name: brand-coral
tokens.usage: Brand primitive «مرجانی». Invite / «you». Never body text on light.

tokens.name: brand-coral-deep
tokens.usage: Brand primitive. Logo top figure on light; coral graphics needing 3:1 on cream.

tokens.name: brand-gold
tokens.usage: Brand primitive «طلایی شامپاینی». Detail, labels on green. Never text on light.

tokens.name: brand-cream
tokens.usage: Brand primitive «کرم». Dominant background; text on green.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Brand primitive «جوهر». Body text; text on coral and gold.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Dark theme uses charcoal (owner decision) so the dark-green cards and the felt stand apart from the page.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, chat panel, game bar. In dark: dark brand green on the charcoal page, always with a line border. Navigation chrome uses surface-chrome.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Headers, menus, secondary buttons, selected nav item. In dark it is the brand green; always separate from surface with line or shadow (1.2:1).

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed wells: fields, segmented track, progress track.

tokens.name: surface-chrome
tokens.usage: Navigation chrome: sidebar, phone top bar, dock (AppShell). Light = surface; dark = raised charcoal #252826 on the #191B1A page (owner decision: page and chrome charcoal, cards stay dark green).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text on bg, surface, surface-raised (14.6:1 light, 14.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata on bg/surface/surface-raised (≥5.8:1 light, ≥6.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: heading
tokens.usage: Headings and logo-coloured text on bg and surface.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Tags and small labels. Gold only in dark.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links; always underlined.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card outlines (not for controls).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Field and control outlines; 3:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary action fill: join, sit, start, rematch, send. Never coral or red.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary fill on hover.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label and icon on primary (11:1).

tokens.name: invite
tokens.usage: Invite and «you» highlights: empty-seat chips, «شما» badge, your-turn pill, mention of you. Fill only, never text on light.

tokens.name: invite-strong
tokens.usage: Coral graphics and rings that must reach 3:1 on the theme ground.

tokens.name: invite-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind a message that mentions you.

tokens.name: on-invite
tokens.usage: Text on invite fills (5.95:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Premium, coins, trophies, detail on green. Fill only on light.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent fills.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions, errors, critical clock. Crimson, kept clearly apart from coral.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on danger fills.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error banner and field-error background.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons, online dot, ready state.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success banner background.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings, clock warn stage, timeout strikes.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning banner background.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral information, hints.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Info banner background.

tokens.name: felt
tokens.usage: Game table felt. Fixed in both themes; never follows the app theme.

tokens.name: felt-rim
tokens.usage: Edge of the felt; in dark it is a lighter rim so the table separates from bg.

tokens.name: felt-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on felt (8.5:1).

tokens.name: felt-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on felt (6.5:1).

tokens.name: felt-line
tokens.usage: Dividers and empty slots on felt.

tokens.name: felt-plate
tokens.usage: Information plates sitting on the felt (turn pill, shared resources).

tokens.name: focus-on-felt
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on felt and on primary-green fills (4.8:1).

tokens.name: felt-gold
tokens.usage: Labels and highlights on felt (4.8:1).

tokens.name: seat-1

tokens.name: seat-outline
tokens.usage: Hairline around seat colour tokens so light seats read on cream.

tokens.name: clock-calm
tokens.usage: Clock text and ring above 50% of the turn.

tokens.name: clock-warn
tokens.usage: Clock between 50% and the critical threshold.

tokens.name: clock-critical
tokens.usage: Clock in the critical stage (live tables: last 10 s; turn-based: last hour; lowSeconds in Table.tsx).

tokens.name: clock-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled part of a clock ring on app surfaces.

tokens.name: clock-on-felt-warn
tokens.usage: Clock warn stage on felt.

tokens.name: clock-on-felt-critical
tokens.usage: Clock critical stage on felt (5.3:1).

tokens.name: clock-on-felt-frozen
tokens.usage: Clock frozen by a server incident, on felt (5.6:1).

tokens.name: coin-light
tokens.usage: Coin highlight (top-left of the metallic gradient).

tokens.name: coin
tokens.usage: Coin body: real metallic gold, not brand gold, so money reads as money.

tokens.name: coin-dark
tokens.usage: Coin rim and embossing shadow.

tokens.name: tier-bronze
tokens.usage: Bronze trophies and league.

tokens.name: tier-silver
tokens.usage: Silver trophies and league.

tokens.name: tier-gold
tokens.usage: Gold trophies and league (brand gold).

tokens.name: tier-turquoise
tokens.usage: Turquoise trophies; platinum league.

tokens.name: tier-diamond
tokens.usage: Diamond trophies and league.

tokens.name: tier-master
tokens.usage: Master league.

styles.name: t-h1
styles.usage: Marketing page titles, hero on desktop.

styles.name: t-h2
styles.usage: Section titles on marketing pages; big result headline.

styles.name: t-h3
styles.usage: Card and section titles in the app.

styles.name: t-page
styles.usage: App page title on desktop (24px on phones via t-page-sm).

styles.name: t-body
styles.sample: قوانین را یاد بگیر و همین حالا بازی کن.

styles.name: t-body-sm

styles.name: t-label
styles.usage: Buttons, field labels, nav items (brand label).

styles.name: t-micro
styles.usage: Badges, counters, HUD stat labels. Minimum size in the product.

styles.name: t-num-lg
styles.usage: Primary stat in an expanded player card, wallet balance.

styles.name: t-num-md
styles.usage: Primary stat in a compact player card, own clock.

styles.name: t-latin
styles.usage: Latin names (original game titles), codes, URLs. Same size as the Persian role it sits beside.

tokens.name: space-20

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags, small inline marks.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, nav items, menu items (brand button radius).

tokens.name: radius-md

tokens.usage: Game table felt, bottom sheets, mobile dock.

tokens.usage: Chips, badges, avatars, turn pill.

tokens.name: radius-tile

shadow.note: Claymorphism: every pressable control is a tile with a bottom lip; pressing sinks it. Cards float softly; the felt is sunk.

tokens.name: shadow-tile
tokens.usage: Clay tile: secondary buttons, segmented selection, chips. The bottom lip is what makes a control look pressable.

tokens.name: shadow-tile-primary
tokens.usage: Clay tile on primary and danger fills.

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: Pressed state: the tile sinks (pair with translateY 1px).

tokens.name: shadow-field
tokens.usage: Recessed fields and tracks.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and panels (always with a line border).

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, sheets, dialogs, toasts, mobile dock.

tokens.name: shadow-felt
tokens.usage: The game table: a felt sunk into its rim.

tokens.name: shadow-piece
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles and boards lying on the felt.
